    """Return the length of the longest consecutive run of the same character. Empty text returns 0. Characters are case-sensitive."""
reference_code:
def longest_run(text):
    best = current = 0
    previous = None
    for char in text:
        current = current + 1 if char == previous else 1
        best = max(best, current)
        previous = char
    return best
